description: Draws a line of your own text down the panel, with the typeface, size, colour, glow and letter spacing set from the knobs and the text itself typed in from the right-click menu

params.text: Chooses the typeface by stepping through the font files in the plugin's own fonts folder; two ship with it, a sans and a bold serif
Sets the height of the lettering, 8 to 76pt
Sets the hue of the lettering, running once round the colour wheel across its travel
Sets how strong the colour is, grey lettering at the bottom of its travel and full colour halfway up; the top half does nothing, because the drawing clamps saturation at 1 and this knob goes to 2
Sets how far the glow spreads behind the lettering, 0 to 15; with a cable in the glow jack this knob stops setting the glow and scales that voltage instead
Sets how tightly the letters are packed, 0.4 to 1.2 times the font's own spacing

inputs.text: Turns the hue on from where the hue knob has it, 10V taking it once round the colour wheel; past the end it wraps rather than stopping
Each pulse above 1V flips the lettering between the colour the saturation knob sets and plain grey
Adds to the size knob at 5pt per volt, with the total held between 8 and 76pt
Sets the glow whenever a cable is in it: -5V for none, 0V for half of what the glow knob says, and +5V for all of it

notes: the module comes up reading Your Text Here; right-click the panel, choose Edit Text and type, and the lettering changes as you go, because the text box is parked off the panel out of sight
the panel prints no names at all; the controls run down it in this order: typeface, size, size CV, hue, hue CV, saturation, clock, glow, glow CV, spacing
a Text Effects Expander put immediately to the left or right takes over the lettering, and removing it brings the text you typed back
the saturation saved into the patch is the one in use, not the one on the knob, so saving while the clock has the lettering grey and reopening leaves the knob itself on zero
menu: Edit Text — puts the cursor in the module's text box with the current text selected, so whatever you type next replaces it

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.2:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
inputs.3:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
